_comment: Experiments whose predictions were committed to docs/lab/PROGRAMME_PLAN.md before the experiment file, but without writing the experiment's id. Each link names that commit; the checker accepts it only if the commit changed the plan and is earlier than the experiment file. This is not an exemption: a link to a later commit still fails.

E-PAYRUN-ANALYST-ACCURACY-01.why: The predictions section 'Does the pay run reviewer make mistakes that break accuracy?' was committed before lab/experiments/128-payrun-analyst-accuracy.js existed, but named the test in words, not by its id. The slip was found by this check on 2026-11-13.
